question: The SiC scattering strength for particles of R <= 5 nm is bracketed by the density-only and stiffness-only contrast of the Rayleigh-to-geometric model (reduction per 1 at% C at R = 2.5 nm, x = 0.2, 300 K: 12.5% to 27.2%). Which part of that band, if any, does an atomistic simulation with an explicit, relaxed, lattice-mismatched SiC/SiGe interface support?
no_compute_precheck: decision_robustness.json (committed with this design): the stiffness bracket already sits within 0.5% of the geometric-cap limit of the model form, and the screening pick (x = 0.3, 3 at% C) is the same across the whole band; only the preferred radius (2.5 vs 5 nm) and the size of the Ge saving (27% to 51%) depend on the contrast.

method.engine: LAMMPS (CHPC module lammps, openmpi/4.1.6), Muller-Plathe rNEMD, protocol identical to chpc/in.mp_kappa2 (NPT 50 ps, warm 100 ps, production 500 ps, swap every 50 steps, 20 z-bins)
method.potential: md/SiCGe_GeC.tersoff = LAMMPS SiCGe.tersoff (Tersoff 1989) + 12 Ge-C triplets by the upstream mixing rules with chi_GeC = 1; gate G1 guarantees they are never evaluated
method.host: Si0.8Ge0.2 random alloy, 12 x 12 x 40 diamond cells (about 6.6 x 6.6 x 21.9 nm, 46080 sites)
method.particle: two 3C-SiC spheres (a = 4.36 A before relaxation), centred at z = Lz/4 and 3Lz/4, radius R; every Ge within R + 7 A of a centre is converted to Si (Si-rich pocket, consistent with the converged MACE site preference); overlaps < 1.6 A deleted; box relaxed (aniso) before dynamics
method.runs: md/points.txt: host (2 seeds); for R = 10, 15, 20 A: shell-only control and particle, 2 seeds each; 14 runs, T = 300 K
method.placement: notchpeak-guest / owner-guest, 32 ranks, requeue; grn061 and the DGX are not used

gates.G1: for every particle run, at start and end: (min distance of any Ge atom to its nearest particle centre) - (max distance of any C atom to its nearest centre) >= 5.7 A
gates.G2: every run completes with MPT_EPROD present and analyze_mp.py producing a finite kappa
gates.G3: mean C coordination (Si + C neighbours within 2.3 A) at the end >= 3.3 (particle stays crystalline; surface atoms lower the mean)
gates.G4: the two host seeds agree within 8%

analysis.reduction: r_MD(R) = 1 - kappa(particle, R) / kappa(shell-only, R), seed-paired, reported as mean and the two-seed half range
analysis.phi_eff: per half: V_particle / (A_xy * 7 * Lz / 20), the volume of the 7 bins analyze_mp.py fits in each half
analysis.model_side: nano_sigec SModes at x = 0.2, 300 K, with (i) intrinsic rates scaled by one factor f so that bulk kappa equals the Tersoff kappa_inf of the P1 final law at x = 0.2, 300 K (1/(0.209 + 1.919*0.2 - 2.244*0.04 + 8.35e-5*300) = 1.894 W/mK), then (ii) a boundary length d chosen so that the model equals the mean MD shell-only kappa at the same R; the particle is then added at phi_eff and R, giving r_model(lam2)
analysis.lam2_eff: bisection of r_model(lam2) = r_MD over lam2 in [0, 1e6]; band edges: density contrast (0.0093) and geometric cap (lam2 = 1e6)

predictions.PrS2: for all three radii, r_MD lies between r_model(density) and r_model(cap), within the two-seed half range

decision_rule.inside_band: strengthen the small-SiC claims with a narrowed band: recompute the Ge saving and the reduction at R = 2.5 and 5 nm with lam2 restricted to [min, max] of lam2_eff over radii and seeds; the narrowed interval replaces 27% to 51%
decision_rule.above_cap: if r_MD exceeds r_model(cap) beyond the half range for any radius: correct the model form (the explicit interface scatters more than any contrast in the Rayleigh-to-geometric form allows); fit an effective-radius multiplier R_eff/R on the three radii and report the corrected Ge saving
decision_rule.below_density: if r_MD is below r_model(density) beyond the half range for any radius: downweight the few-nm SiC claims and report the MD-bounded saving
decision_rule.extrapolation_note: the claims concern R = 2.5 and 5 nm; the check runs R = 1.0 to 2.0 nm because larger particles need larger boxes. lam2_eff (or R_eff/R) is assumed constant in R; the trend over the three radii is reported so a reader can judge that assumption
